# lines.types: Line2D

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> A straight bounded span, directed from A to B. The point at parameter t in
> \[0, 1\] is A + (B - A) \* t (t = 0 is A, t = 1 is B) -- the same parametric
> contract the ray and line types state. Degenerate when A equals B.

## Signature

```plato
type Line2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IOpenShape, IConnected, IBounded2D, ILength, IPointSet2D, ICentroid2D, INearestPoint2D, IDeformable2D
```

```plato
//==
// # Lines
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Line segments, infinite lines, and rays
//  - Planes, half-spaces, and slabs

//==
// # Line segments, infinite lines, and rays
//
// The one-dimensional flat (affine) primitives. Extent distinguishes them: a
// segment (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Line_segment) is bounded by two endpoints,
// a ray (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ray_(geometry)) extends one way from its
// origin, and a line (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Line_(geometry)) extends both
// ways. The two-dimensional flats and the regions they bound follow in the
// next section.

//==
// # Segments

// A straight bounded span, directed from A to B. The point at parameter t in
// [0, 1] is A + (B - A) * t (t = 0 is A, t = 1 is B) -- the same parametric
// contract the ray and line types state. Degenerate when A equals B.
type Line2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IOpenShape, IConnected, IBounded2D, ILength, IPointSet2D, ICentroid2D, INearestPoint2D, IDeformable2D
{
    A: Point2D;
    B: Point2D;
}
```
